name: app-says-thinks-does-feels-persona-quadrant-with-orb
title: Says, Thinks, Does, Feels Persona Quadrant
whatItIs: A light grey slide titled User Persona with a headline that shifts from grey to black, and an empathy map of four icon pills (Says, Thinks, Does, Feels) with short texts around a central gradient orb holding a portrait, divided by crosshair lines.
whatItMeans: The orb at the centre puts the person first, and four quadrants organise insights cleanly.
techniques: Gradient orb behind the central portrait
Short quotes in small grey text

vocabulary.definition: A four-part diagram of what a user says, thinks, does and feels.
A page divided into four equal areas.
A glowing circle placed at the heart of a diagram.
